messages:
maria: Heads-up — prepping paid search + retarget push to support Thursday webinar (11am PT). Need quick plan: budget pacing, retarget windows, and 1st-pass creative. Who can own what?
ben: I can own search setup and pacing. Recommend 3-day and 14-day retarget lists. Start with $1.2k/day, can ramp to $2k after creative proves out.
ella: I’ll do creative variants — two headlines (webinar benefit vs. benchmark narrative) + 2 image options for retarget carousel. Want CTA to be 'Join live' + registration urgency line.
sam: Analytics: will build UTM/template and live dashboard. Suggest send attribution window 7d click / 1d view for webinar conversions. Also set CPA alert at $120.
maria: For retargeting, do we want to exclude folks who registered in last 30d?
ben: Yes exclude 30d registrants, frequency cap 3/day. Retarget windows: 0-3d (high-intent), 4-14d (mid), 15-30d (low). Bid aggressiveness: highest for 0-3d.
ella: Creative idea: variant A uses benchmark stat "2x throughput at 1/3 cost" as headline; variant B is soft: "See how teams cut inference cost". Which should be the search ad headline vs retarget?
ben: Put stat headline in search exact-match and branded discovery. Retarget carousel test both.
maria: Sam — can you drop the tracking template here? Also include the dashboard link so PMs can watch.
sam: Tracking snippet below — throw into Final URL Suffix or tracking template:
```
utm_source=google&utm_medium=cpc&utm_campaign=webinar_mar26&utm_term={keyword}&utm_content={ad_id}
```
Dashboard: https://analytics.redwood.example/dashboards/webinar-mar26 (will share view link in morning).
ben: Also adding ad scheduling: weekdays 6am-10am PT and 4pm-10pm PT, with bid multiplier +15% evening. Dayparting helps CPA.
ella: For retarget creative, I'll prepare two carousels: 3-frame product benefits, 3-frame case-study snapshot. Will export assets by EOD tomorrow.
maria: Budget note — we have $8k total for paid channels for this push. Split suggestion: 60% search, 30% retarget, 10% discovery/social retarget. Thoughts?
ben: Fine. I'll set daily caps accordingly. Also plan a 48-hour post-registration remarketing message with webinar recording to capture no-shows.
ad-bot: Campaign skeleton created in draft: "Webinar_Mar26_Search" and "Webinar_Mar26_Retarget". Reminder: review policy checks before publish.
maria: Great — owners: ben (search + pacing), ella (creative), sam (tracking + dashboard). I'll QA and approve final ads. Launch target: 9am PT Thursday (3 hours before webinar for peak signups).
sam: I’ll add CPA and registration conversion alerts to #marketing-alerts and email to owners.
ben: Quick QA checklist: final URLs confirmed, tracking template applied, audiences uploaded, exclusions set, budget caps in place. I’ll run checklist 1 hour before launch.
ella: Ping me if creative needs resizing — I’ll keep source files in Figma.
maria: OK team — final note: keep creative refresh cadence at day 3 and day 7 after launch, rotate winners into search. :eyes: 
ben: Sounds good. :thumbsup:
ella: on it.
ad-bot: Campaigns scheduled for 2026-03-26 09:00:00 PT pending final publish by ben.
maria: Closing thread — will post final approval screenshot here when live. Thanks!
